headline: Frontline Bases Shift Amid Soaring Casualties
war_summary: Three hours on, the map’s most volatile sectors have deepened their churn. Weathered Expanse remains the hottest zone, now logging fifty‑four base transitions in the past day and seven in the last two hours, with Colonial losses climbing to six hundred per hour and Warden losses to seven hundred thirty, both accelerating. Linn Mercy has surged to twenty‑two daily flips, though none in the freshest window; casualties have spiked sharply to two hundred eleven and four hundred four per hour respectively. Marban Hollow records twenty‑four daily flips and five recent, its casualty trends cooling in the last hour but accelerating over two hours. Nevish Line still sees heavy turnover with twenty‑seven daily flips and two fresh transitions, casualties moderating but still high. Mooring County holds eight daily flips and four in the last two hours, losses low but rising. Stonecradle adds five daily flips and two fresh, casualties moderate and accelerating. Meanwhile the meat‑grinders at Callahans Passage and Dead Lands bleed heavily without base movement, and Farranac Coast and Godcrofts have tapered to quiet. Enlistment spikes persist across all contested fronts, suggesting the current flare‑ups may sustain through the next day.
